    width, height = observation['grid_width'], observation['grid_height']
    obstacles = observation['obstacles']

    opponent_x, opponent_y = observation['opponent_position']

    target_res = None
    min_res_dist = float('inf')
    for res in resources:
        rx, ry = res
        dist = abs(rx - x) + abs(ry - y)
        if dist < min_res_dist:
            min_res_dist = dist
            target_res = (rx, ry)

    # Determine move towards target
    if target_res:
        dx = target_res[0] - x
        dy = target_res[1] - y

            return [0, step_y]
